metadata.title: MarsWalk 2.0 Planetary Exploration Nomenclature & Place Catalog
primary_sources: USGS Astrogeology Science Center Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature

NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) Mission Archives

places.name: Perseverance Rover (Octavia E. Butler Landing)
places.description: Touching down in Jezero Crater near the ancient river delta, investigating habitable environments and caching rock cores.
places.pds_citation: NASA Mars 2020 Mission Telemetry / PDS Geosciences Node (2021)
places.dataset_attribution: NASA / JPL-Caltech Mars 2020 Telemetry

places.name: Curiosity Rover (Bradbury Landing)
places.description: Landed inside Gale Crater exploring Mount Sharp (Aeolis Mons) strata to understand ancient lakebed habitability.
places.dataset_attribution: NASA / JPL MSL Navigation Team

places.name: InSight Lander
places.description: Geophysical lander placed SEIS seismometer on smooth volcanic plain to measure Marsquakes and core structure.
places.pds_citation: Golombek et al., Space Sci Rev (2020)
places.dataset_attribution: NASA InSight Science Team / PDS Geosciences

places.name: Spirit Rover (Columbia Memorial Station)
places.description: Explored basaltic plains and the Columbia Hills in Gusev Crater, finding silica deposits indicative of ancient hydrothermal activity.
places.dataset_attribution: NASA MER Science Team / PDS

places.name: Opportunity Rover (Challenger Memorial Station)
places.description: Hole-in-one landing in Eagle Crater on hematite-rich plains, discovering hematite blueberries and ancient acid-water sediments.
places.dataset_attribution: NASA MER Science Team / PDS

places.name: Phoenix Mars Lander
places.description: Arctic plain lander that trenched polygon terrain, exposing subsurface pure water-ice and perchlorates.
places.dataset_attribution: NASA / UA Phoenix Mission Team

places.name: Viking 1 Lander (Thomas Mutch Memorial Station)
places.description: First successful US Mars landing; operated for over six years conducting soil biology experiments and imaging.
places.dataset_attribution: NASA Viking Project Team

places.name: Viking 2 Lander (Gerald Soffen Memorial Station)
places.description: Northern boulder-strewn plain landing; operated seismometer and analyzed frost condensation.
places.dataset_attribution: NASA Viking Project Team

places.name: Mars Pathfinder & Sojourner (Carl Sagan Station)
places.description: Cataclysmic outflow floodplain landing, deploying Sojourner, the first wheeled micro-rover on another planet.
places.dataset_attribution: NASA / JPL Mars Pathfinder Team

places.name: Zhurong Rover (Tianwen-1 Lander)
places.description: Subsurface radar exploration across southern Utopia Planitia investigating paleo-oceanic sedimentary structures.
places.dataset_attribution: CNSA Tianwen-1 Ground Application System
